senses: to tremble, dread, fear, oppress, prevail, break, be terrified, cause to tremble
to regard or treat with awe, regard or treat as awful

strongs.def: to awe or (intransitive) to dread; hence, to harass
strongs.kjv: be affrighted (afraid, dread, feared, terrified), break, dread, fear, oppress, prevail, shake terribly
